travel.headline: Check seasonal road status and toll requirements
travel.reservation: Access to the high-alpine route typically involves a toll fee at the valley entrance. While advance reservations for the road itself are not standard, travelers should verify seasonal opening dates and current weather conditions via the official Kaunertal Glacier site before departure.

days.title: Ascent to the Eternal Ice

stops.name: Kaunertal Glacier Road
stops.detail: Drive the meandering route from the valley floor to the glacier's edge, observing the transition of high-altitude flora and fauna.

days.driving: Allow 2 to 4 hours for the round-trip drive; conditions vary with elevation.
days.note: Expect steep gradients and hairpins as the road climbs into the high-alpine zone.

intel.title: Glacier Access
intel.text: Parking is available at the end of the road near the glacier. Evidence does not specify fill times, so arrive early during peak summer periods.

intel.title: Connectivity Gaps
intel.text: Mobile reception may be intermittent or unavailable in deep valley sections and high-altitude peaks. Download offline maps before leaving the valley floor.

intel.title: Valley Services
intel.text: Ensure your vehicle is fully fueled in Feichten or the lower valley. There are no documented fuel stations along the steep ascent to the glacier.

intel.title: Weather Awareness
intel.text: High-altitude conditions can change rapidly even in summer. Check the local forecast for fog or snow that may impact visibility on the scenic curves.

intel.title: Road Restrictions
intel.text: The road is a high-altitude alpine route with numerous switchbacks. Verify if there are specific length or weight restrictions for larger vehicles like motorhomes.

plan.arrival: Begin in the town of Feichten to check road status, secure supplies, and begin the ascent toward the glacier terminal.
plan.vehicle: Suitable for cars and motorcycles; RV drivers should check for hairpin turn restrictions and braking requirements for the descent.
plan.goldenHour: The glacier terminus offers expansive views, though sunset timing varies significantly by month in the high Alps.
